constraints: No external dependencies may be added; implementation and tests must use Node.js built-ins and existing local helpers.
The retry reset command contract must remain unchanged: `sdd-forge flow set retry reset <gate|review> <phase> --reason <text> --yes`.
A simple append-only change to issue-log.json must not be sufficient changed evidence for review impl or gate task-impl recovery.
Recovery evidence source changes must stay phase-scoped; unrelated recovery phases must retain their current source meaning unless explicitly covered by this spec.
design_principles: Align recovery evidence with the artifacts that prompts instruct users to modify.
Keep retry recovery fingerprinting file-based to fit the existing EvidenceFingerprint model.
Prefer adding phase-specific paths over adding special-case reset behavior.
Preserve issue-log as an audit trail, not as a standalone unlock mechanism.

modules.text: `src/flow/lib/retry-recovery.js` owns retry recovery targets, phase evidence sources, fingerprints, eligibility checks, and reset grants.
`src/flow/lib/set-retry.js` invokes recovery eligibility before applying an exhausted retry reset grant.
`src/flow/prompts/impl/impl-review.md` and `impl-gate.md` instruct operators to record intentional guardrail exception acknowledgements in spec.json.

data_flow.text: On retry exhaustion, run-review or run-gate persists a recovery baseline fingerprint. `flow set retry reset` later builds the current fingerprint from the phase evidence source and grants one re-evaluation only when the source hash changes.
After this change, review impl and gate task-impl fingerprints include both implementation files under src and the active spec.json file. issue-log.json remains excluded for these phases.

decisions.text: Use file-level spec.json evidence rather than field-level acknowledgement parsing.
decisions.evidence: The existing EvidenceFingerprint model hashes file paths selected by RecoveryEvidenceSource. Adding spec.json as a source path satisfies acknowledgement repair tests without introducing a new JSON diff subsystem.
decisions.consideredAlternatives: Field-level diff parsing was rejected because it adds parser policy and edge cases outside the issue scope.

decisions.text: Keep issue-log.json excluded for review impl and gate task-impl recovery.
decisions.evidence: Issue #364 requires that a simple append-only issue-log.json change must not allow retry reset for unintended phases.

background: Issue #364 identifies a mismatch between retry recovery guidance and recovery eligibility. The impl-review and impl-gate prompts can direct users to fix intentional guardrail exceptions by editing spec.json acknowledgement surfaces, but retry recovery currently fingerprints only src for review impl and gate task-impl. This means the correct prompt-guided fix can be rejected as unchanged evidence after retry exhaustion.

requirements.desc: For review impl retry recovery, the phase evidence source must include the active spec.json file in addition to src, so a spec.json acknowledgement change can produce changed evidence without an unrelated src change.

For gate task-impl retry-exhausted recovery, the phase evidence source must include the active spec.json file in addition to src, so a spec.json acknowledgement change can produce changed evidence without an unrelated src change.
For review impl and gate task-impl, issue-log.json must not be part of the phase evidence source, so an issue-log-only append does not satisfy changed evidence for those phases.
Spec-local tests under specs/279-retry-recovery-evidence/tests/ must cover R1, R2, and R3 through recovery evidence source and eligibility behavior.

acceptance_criteria: For kind=review and canonicalPhase=impl, resolveRecoveryEvidenceSource returns paths containing src and the active spec.json path.
For kind=gate and canonicalPhase=task-impl, resolveRecoveryEvidenceSource returns paths containing src and the active spec.json path.
A recovery baseline captured before a spec.json acknowledgement change and evaluated after that change reports changed-evidence for review impl.
A recovery baseline captured before a spec.json acknowledgement change and evaluated after that change reports changed-evidence for gate task-impl.
Changing only issue-log.json does not make review impl or gate task-impl recovery eligible when src and spec.json are unchanged.
Existing evidence sources for draft question review, draft coverage review, spec review, test review, and integration gate remain unchanged unless already covered by this spec.

clarifications.q: Should acknowledgement evidence be limited to specific spec.json fields?
clarifications.a: No for this change. The implementation should add the active spec.json file to the phase evidence source and verify acknowledgement-field changes through tests. Field-level parsing is out of scope.

clarifications.q: Should issue-log.json become a recovery evidence source?
clarifications.a: No for review impl and gate task-impl. issue-log.json is an audit trail here, and a simple append-only change must not unlock retry reset.

clarifications.q: Does this change alter retry limits or grant count?
clarifications.a: No. The command contract, configured max attempts, and one-attempt recovery grant remain unchanged.

alternatives_considered.option: Parse spec.json and only hash acknowledgement fields
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because the existing retry recovery model selects file paths and hashes files. Field-level parsing adds policy complexity outside Issue #364.

alternatives_considered.option: Include issue-log.json as changed evidence for all retry recovery phases
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because it would allow retry reset by appending audit text, contradicting the requirement that issue-log-only changes not unlock unintended phases.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep src-only evidence and update prompts to require source changes
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because prompt-guided spec.json acknowledgement is the correct repair surface for intentional guardrail exceptions.
